decisions.why: `— स्रोत: 2025/set_jv · खण्ड अ` states which paper a question came from, which is exactly what the question head's chip carries for every OTHER question (`5 अंक · 2026/set_dw · खण्ड य`). The information is on the page; only the redundant label is not. Author artefact in the markdown, confirmed with the author.
